changelog:
Initial release of the character-sheet skill:

- Generates four-panel character sheets from user descriptions for visual reference.
- Includes primary views (front, side, back), facial close-ups and color palettes, detailed accessory/feature breakdowns, and full-body proportion comparisons.
- Ensures all images maintain strict consistency in character appearance, proportions, and color schemes across prompts.
- Triggers skill when users mention terms like "角色设定", "三视图", "人物设计", or "画角色".
summary: 生成角色正面/侧面/背面三视图，附带配色板与细节拆解
